question: Do honest Qwen3-14B proofs pass real Full verification, and what does the model need from miners and verifiers?
host: Rented research Pod, 2x NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB: producer on GPU 0, verifier on GPU 1 (gpu/model_session.sh, gpu/plan_host.py)

run.chain: Private research chain registering the candidate; not mainnet

rejections.rule: full-r1 v4 Full hard cap on the best-p candidate's logit severity (12 sigma)
rejections.cause: At the flagged steps an MCA-noised replay candidate won best-p, so the cap measured injected noise. On the two rejected proofs whose candidates were captured, the unperturbed batch-1 replay peaked at 1.22 and 1.43 sigma.

fullR2.change: The Full logit-severity cap reads the unperturbed batch-1 replay at every step, not the best-p candidate. Cap, p-values, sampling-noise selection and every other rule unchanged (patches/noet-miner.patch, full_gates.py, FULL_RULES_REVISION full-r2-2026-10-21).

forgeries.change: +4 on step 100's top logit, bf16 grid
+4 on step 100's top logit, bf16 grid
forgeries.rule: full-r2 reference replay logit severity 17.43 sigma at step 100

limits: One host type (A100 80 GB) for both producer and verifier; other miner GPUs are not yet measured.
33 Full verdicts. The false-RED rate under full-r2 needs a longer run; the unperturbed replay stayed at or below 1.43 sigma on the 32 proofs where it was captured.
Prompt-gate calibration, difficulty for the new attempt time and the switch height are not yet set (models/README.md).
A proof produced by a smaller model and labelled 14B was not tested here.
